title: Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services: Annual Accumulation Toward the Medicare KX Threshold
content:
Allowed amounts on Medicare Part B therapy visits under **Outpatient and Part B Therapy Services** accumulate, year by year, toward the Medicare therapy KX threshold.

## Rule

> Allowed amounts count toward the KX threshold per calendar year across all of the resident's Part B plans in the same threshold group: physical therapy and speech-language pathology together, occupational therapy alone. Once a group's allowed amounts for the year exceed the KX threshold of that year, further visits in the group are covered only with medical-necessity documentation in the record and the KX modifier attached; past the targeted medical review threshold, claims may be reviewed. The annual Part B deductible is one deductible shared with every other Part B service at the center.

## How the total is measured

- **What is added.** The payer allowed amount of each treatment visit or evaluation line.
- **Which visits.** Visits on all of the resident's Medicare Part B plans in the same threshold group: the Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care and the Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care form one group; the Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care forms its own group. Every Part B plan of the resident in the group counts, not only the plan the visit is on.
- **Which year.** The calendar year of the service date. Each calendar year's total starts afresh.
- **Against what amount.** The KX threshold of that year: $2410.00 for 2025 and $2480.00 for 2026. The targeted medical review threshold is $3000.00 of allowed amount per threshold group per year.
- **Tiers outside the threshold.** The allowed amounts of the Medicare Advantage Outpatient Therapy Plan of Care, the Medical Assistance Therapy Plan of Care and the Private Pay Therapy Plan of Care count toward no KX threshold group.
- **Resident notice.** In the three Medicare Part B tiers the resident is told when allowed amounts reach the KX threshold.

## Input — judgement — result

| Input | Judgement | Result |
|---|---|---|
| A group's allowed amounts for the year exceed that year's KX threshold | Further visits in the group | Covered only with medical-necessity documentation in the record and the KX modifier attached |
| A group's allowed amounts for the year are past $3000.00 | Claims of the group | May be reviewed |

## Worked figures (hypothetical resident, service year 2026)

| Plan | Allowed amounts so far in 2026 |
|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Physical Therapy Plan of Care | $1671.38 |
| Medicare Part B Speech-Language Pathology Plan of Care | $862.95 |
| Medicare Part B Occupational Therapy Plan of Care | $1209.74 |

- Physical therapy and speech-language pathology together: $1671.38 plus $862.95 is $2534.33, which exceeds the 2026 threshold of $2480.00. Further 2026 visits on either of those two plans are covered only with medical-necessity documentation in the record and the KX modifier attached. The total has not passed $3000.00.
- Occupational therapy alone: $1209.74, counted on its own against its own $2480.00, has not exceeded the 2026 threshold.

**Does a December 2025 visit count toward the 2026 total?** No. It counts toward 2025, against the 2025 amount of $2410.00; the 2026 total is made up of visits with 2026 service dates.

## The shared deductible

The annual Part B deductible is one deductible shared with every other Part B service at the center; therapy visits do not have a deductible of their own.
